correctness.rationale: For all a,b,c,d>0 the proposed rational map preserves H by direct algebra. In log coordinates, H=d(e^u+e^v)+a(e^-u+e^-v)+c e^(u+v)+b e^(−u−v) is proper strictly convex with unique minimizer (ln s,ln s), cs^4+ds^3−as−b=0. The transformed map is symplectic and H-preserving, commutes with Hamiltonian flow and acts by rigid rotation on each oval. Its displacement about equilibrium has negative cross-product for −2<k<0, yielding a continuous clockwise lift in (0,1/2). Linearized trace δ−1 gives ρ_min=acos((δ−1)/2)/(2π). At high log energy, max of six affine forms produces an invariant hexagon and order-3 linear map A(U,V)=(V,−U−V), so ρ∞=1/3. If ad=bc, g(v) constant and T^3=identity; otherwise endpoint angles differ, continuous ρ has interval image, and every sufficiently large prime denominator and irrational rotation appears. Independent SymPy test checks invariant and T^3 special case; numerical tests are corroboration.
